entry.title: Trijam 313 entry: Strange Cravings Restaurant
entry.content:
Last weekend I participated in Trijam #313.

Trijam is a weekly game jam where your goal is to make something playable (and fun!) in just 3 hours.

The theme

The theme for this game jam was “Strange Cravings”.

This was the seventh Trijam that I participated with purpose to test my small game engine: Blazorame.

The game

Welcome to Strange Cravings Restaurant, where you play as a krab running an undersea diner that caters to the bizarre cravings of deep-sea creatures! Your goal? Fulfill as many strange orders as possible before time runs out—while managing a chaotic kitchen conveyor system.

Food arrives from the kitchen on four food mats, but not everything is part of the current order. If it’s the wrong dish, quickly recycle it to save money. Drop food on the floor, and you’ll lose cash! Inspired by classic Atari 2600 arcade gameplay, this fast-paced challenge will test your reflexes and decision-making. Can you out-earn the other krab restaurant owners and become the ultimate deep-sea chef?

Gameplay

  • 🦀 Move – Use the arrow keys to navigate.
  • 🍽 Serve Orders – Deliver the correct food to earn $10.
  • ♻ Recycle – Dispose of incorrect food for $1.
  • ❌Dropped Food – Lose $5 per fallen dish.
  • ⏳ Time Limit – You have 120 seconds to make as much money as possible!

The final result is: Strange Cravings Restaurant.

How to play

The game can be played directly on the browser here: https://giacomelli.itch.io/strange-cravings-restaurant.

How to vote

If you liked the game, you can cast a vote for the game jam here: https://itch.io/jam/trijam-313/rate/3401145.

entry.title: Trijam 310 entry: Bloodsuckers Invaders
entry.content:
Last weekend I participated in Trijam #310.

Trijam is a weekly game jam where your goal is to make something playable (and fun!) in just 3 hours.

The theme

The theme for this game jam was “Vampires”.

This was the sixth Trijam that I participated with purpose to test my small game engine: Blazorame.

The night has fallen, and the creatures of darkness are closing in! Bloodsuckers Invaders is a retro arcade shooter inspired by Space Invaders but with a vampiric twist. Armed with a holy cross-shaped stake, your mission is to drive back wave after wave of bloodthirsty monsters before they overrun the land.

Monsters of the Night:

  • 🦇 Blood Bats – Fast and erratic winged creatures.
  • 🕴️Dhampirs – Half-human, half-vampire hybrids.
  • 🩸 Strigoi – Undead vampires with a thirst for destruction.
  • 🕶️ Nosferatu – Shadowy and terrifying.
  • 🐺 Werewolves – As dangerous as they are relentless.
  • 🧛Dracula – The Dark Lord himself, descending as the final boss. Defeat him to end the invasion, but beware—he’s not an easy target!

The final result is: Bloodsuckers Invaders.

How to play

The game can be played directly on the browser here: https://giacomelli.itch.io/bloodsuckers-invaders.

entry.title: Trijam 309 entry: Bombing
entry.content:
Last weekend I participated in Trijam #309.

Trijam is a weekly game jam where your goal is to make something playable (and fun!) in just 3 hours.

The theme

The theme for this game jam was “Dangerous Choices”.

This was the fifth Trijam that I participated with purpose to test my small game engine: Blazorame.

In Bombing, you take control of a military plane pilot tasked with bombing enemy military lines while carefully avoiding civilian buildings. Inspired by classic Atari 2600 arcade gameplay, every drop of your bomb is a dangerous choice—will you strike the enemy or cause collateral damage?

Gameplay

  • Bomb military buildings (pink) to earn points.
  • Avoid hitting civilian buildings—each mistake costs you points.
  • Destroy all military buildings to advance to the next level.
  • With every level, your plane gets faster, making precision even more critical.
  • Game Over if you destroy all civilian buildings or crash into any building.

The final result is: Bombing.

entry.title: Trijam 307 entry: Web Of Bugs
entry.content:
Last weekend I participated in Trijam #307.

Trijam is a weekly game jam where your goal is to make something playable (and fun!) in just 3 hours.

The theme

The theme for this game jam was “Web Of Issues”.

This was the fourth Trijam that I participated with purpose to test my small game engine: Blazorame.

This Atari 2600-style arcade game where you play as a hungry spider, fighting to survive the relentless waves of insects invading your web at night.

🕷️ Survive, Hunt, and Weave!

  • Every time you throw a web, you lose a portion of your web (bottom bar).
  • Hit a bug with your web to turn it into a cocoon.
  • Eat cocoons to regain the web and stay in the fight.
  • Bugs that collide with a cocoon also get trapped—use this to your advantage!

The final result is: Web Of Bugs.

entry.title: Trijam 243 entry: The Cursed Idol
entry.content:
Last weekend I participated in Trijam #243.

Trijam is a weekly game jam where your goal is to make something playable (and fun!) in just 3 hours.

The theme

The theme for this game jam was “Cursed Relics”.

This was the third Trijam that I participated with purpose to test my small game engine: Blazorame.

This quick-time event game is based on the famous Indiana Jones - Raiders of the Lost Ark scene where Indy needs to swap a bag with the Golden Idol to try not to activate the temple traps (we all know how it turns out).

The game’s objective is to hit any key at the exact moment that Indy should swap the items.

You can try to collect as many Cursed Idols as you want, but if you miss the right moment you will lose them all and will be cursed.

The final result is: The Cursed Idol.

entry.title: Trijam 240 entry: Heat or Freeze
entry.content:
Last weekend I participated in Trijam #240.

Trijam is a weekly game jam where your goal is to make something playable (and fun!) in just 3 hours.

The theme

The theme for this game jam was “Hot and cold”.

This was the second Trijam that I participated with purpose to test my small game engine: Blazorame.

This time I kinda like the game jam theme and I ended up created I simple shooter where you need to use the right gun against each kind of enemy.

The final result is: Heat or Freeze.

You are the ship’s pilot and must survive waves of enemies as much as possible. You have two types of enemies:

  • Hot enemies: can be killed by the Cold Cannon (right)
  • Cold enemies: can be killed by the Hot Cannon (left)

If you hit the enemy with the wrong cannon, the enemy will become stronger, greater, and faster.

How to play

The game can be played directly on the browser here: https://giacomelli.itch.io/heat-or-freeze.

  • A: move the ship to left
  • D: move the ship to right
  • LEFT ARROW: fire the Hot Cannon
  • RIGHT ARROW: fire the Cold Cannon

entry.title: Trijam 239 entry: I need a medic - crossword
entry.content:
Last weekend I participated in Trijam #239.

Trijam is a weekly game jam where your goal is to make something playable (and fun!) in just 3 hours.

The theme

The theme for this game jam was “I need a medic!”.

This was the second Trijam that I participated and it had a different purpose for me, because I wanted to test a small game engine that I I’ve been building from scratch, the idea of this game engine is to develop browser-playable games that look like games from Atari 2600 or Gameboy, for instance: it has a limited palette with just 4 colors like the classic Gameboy had. This game engine is entirely built in C# using Blazor. The games built with it are Blazor WebAssembly apps.

The name of this small game engine is Blazorame.

As I didn’t like much this Trijam theme, I ended up just creating a kinda of crossword game, even so This helped to understand the next steps needed to improve the Blazorame.

How to play

The game can be played directly on the browser here: https://giacomelli.itch.io/i-need-a-medic-crossword.

  • SPACE: to use the current selected letter.
